source.notes: Each Vizgen run is one section (author's decision, 2026-09-10). Runs with Vizgen cell outputs (cell_by_gene.csv + cell_metadata.csv) are ingested as cells; runs that shipped only decoded transcripts (barcodes.csv, no cell assignment) are binned on a 10 um grid (spatial_unit bin, segmentation grid). Codebook VZG116: 307 genes + 78 blanks; barcode_id indexes codebook rows. Raw images are on the AWS Open Data bucket s3://czb-tabula-muris-senis/spatial-transcriptomics/MERFISH-data/ (not used). No per-section image here.
